summary: Add capability-gated iOS test-client command admission and canonical signed-result support; native lifecycle integration remains disabled pending codegen

schema.detail: No schema changes or handwritten wire models.

compatibility.detail: Normal apps never subscribe to commands; test-client commands fail closed without an authoritative grant source.

manual.detail: No pairing or enrollment performed; test-client flag, lifecycle codegen and native SHA-256 adapter are prerequisites.

recovery.detail: Test-mode pairing retains its device signing key and optional device/session identity; existing profiles without identity fail closed. Normal pairing is unchanged.
